summary: Constant device usage can quietly hijack a person's well-being, negatively impacting **sleep quality, family bonding, and overall daily motivation**. To reclaim his life, the speaker instituted **strict evening digital boundaries** and learned to become **comfortably difficult to reach** by ignoring the urge to reply to every incoming ping immediately. By **batching communication times** and relying on a physical notepad instead of a screen, he successfully lowered his daily screen time and rediscovered mental peace. Ultimately, breaking this dopamine-driven habit requires **intentional lifestyle adjustments** that teach individuals how to disconnect from constant notifications and **lead by positive example**.
